title: Render Waterfall expanded row details after selection
observed_behavior: While building Waterfall detail coverage, selecting cluster/node/link rows populated `expandedClusterRowData`, `expandedNodeRowData`, and `expandedLinkRowData` in component state, but the expected expansion text such as uploaded node metadata did not render reliably in the visible Waterfall tables within the maintained Cypress timeout.
intended_behavior: Selecting a Waterfall row should both populate the detail state and render the matching expansion content in the visible PrimeNG table so the user can read the detail rows.
cause_summary: Waterfall still used the legacy PrimeNG expansion template token and also combined `pSelectableRow` with `pRowToggler` on the same table row, so expansion keys were not stable and the expanded DOM row never rendered reliably.
fix_summary: Waterfall now uses PrimeNG 21's `expandedrow` template contract, component-owned expanded-row keys, and selection-driven expansion without `pRowToggler`, so the visible cluster/node/link expansion rows render reliably and W014-W016 assert the DOM directly.
notes: Closed after `waterfall-details-uploaded.cy.ts` passed 5/5 in headless Chrome on April 4, 2026.

title: Refresh Waterfall on threshold-only visibility updates
observed_behavior: With Waterfall already open on the uploaded TN93 distance-edgelist fixture, lowering the global threshold from 0.015 to 0.0144 updates the global visible-link count from 17 to 16 while visible nodes and component count stay at 14 and 2, but the selected Waterfall node row keeps its old degree and the Waterfall link table does not shrink to the new visible-link set.
intended_behavior: An open Waterfall drilldown should recompute immediately when threshold changes only the visible links, even if visible nodes and cluster membership stay the same.
cause_summary: Threshold-only link visibility changes did not trigger the shared refresh path that open Waterfall relied on, so the node/link drilldown could keep stale derived rows.
fix_summary: Waterfall now refreshes off shared `networkUpdated` changes and rebuilds its open drilldown from the current visible graph, so threshold-only link changes recompute selected-node degree and visible link rows immediately.
notes: Closed after the maintained Waterfall refresh journey passed in headless Chrome on April 3, 2026. W011 now covers this path directly.

title: Drop hidden clusters from open Waterfall cluster summary
observed_behavior: With Waterfall already open, raising Minimum Cluster Size from 1 to 3 updates the visible network correctly, but Waterfall `clusterTableData` still shows three clusters (`0`, `1`, `2`) instead of dropping the hidden 2-node cluster `1`.
intended_behavior: An open Waterfall cluster summary should immediately reflect only the currently visible clusters after Minimum Cluster Size changes, and Reveal Everything should restore the original rows.
cause_summary: Waterfall previously rebuilt cluster rows from stale session cluster state instead of the current visible graph, so active cluster-table rows could lag filtering changes.
fix_summary: Waterfall now derives cluster rows from the current visible node/link graph and refreshes while active, so Minimum Cluster Size and Reveal Everything update the open cluster summary immediately.
notes: Closed after the maintained Waterfall refresh journey passed in headless Chrome on April 3, 2026. W012 now covers this path directly.

title: Keep Waterfall dataset isolated from timeline checkpoints
observed_behavior: After selecting a Waterfall cluster, node, and link on the uploaded COVID timeline fixture, enabling Timeline and moving to the June 28 2021 checkpoint rebuilt `clusterTableData`, `nodeTableData`, and `linkTableData` from the checkpoint-visible graph. That made Waterfall drop rows that should only disappear in Bubble Map and 2D.
intended_behavior: Timeline checkpoints should update global statistics and the timeline-targeted Bubble Map and 2D datasets only. Waterfall should stay on the non-timeline filtered dataset and preserve its active drilldown even when the selected graph membership is no longer timeline-visible.
cause_summary: Waterfall derived its rows from `getVisibleNodes()` plus endpoint-filtered visible links, so timeline's node-visibility gate leaked directly into the Waterfall dataset and selection state.
fix_summary: Waterfall now sources rows from the timeline-ignoring dataset helpers, so timeline checkpoints still change the global metrics but Waterfall cluster node and link tables plus selection stay stable.
notes: Closed after rerunning the maintained Waterfall refresh and non-target timeline isolation journeys against a fresh local Cypress server on April 10, 2026. W013 and W022 now guard this contract.

title: Release processing modal on direct Waterfall launch
observed_behavior: When File Settings launches directly into Waterfall, the Waterfall tab and cluster rows render, but the shared `Processing Files...` modal never dismisses, so Cypress never sees launch completion and the user stays blocked behind the loading dialog.
intended_behavior: A direct Waterfall launch should close the shared processing modal once Waterfall has visible data and is ready for interaction, just like the other non-2D launchable views.
cause_summary: Waterfall was never publishing `setNetworkRendered(true)` when it was the first rendered launch view, so the shared loading modal waited forever for a signal that only other views emitted.
fix_summary: Waterfall now marks itself rendered once visible Waterfall data exists during refresh, which releases the shared processing modal and allows direct launches to finish cleanly into Waterfall.
notes: Closed after the maintained direct-launch Waterfall smoke matrix passed across the maintained upload formats in headless Chrome on April 4, 2026.

title: Await restored Waterfall default view in session reload
observed_behavior: The first Waterfall session round-trip assertion read the app state too early and reported `commonService.session.style.widgets['default-view'] === '2D Network'` before the restored session had actually finished applying, even though the saved `.microbetrace` file correctly serialized `\default-view\":\"Waterfall\"`."
intended_behavior: The maintained Waterfall session round-trip coverage should wait on restored session state before asserting the saved default view, so it only reports a failure when the live reloaded session truly loses Waterfall as its launch view.
cause_summary: The spec used the stale `session.network.isFullyLoaded` flag as its reload gate. That flag can already be `true` from the initial Files tab before the restored session finishes applying, so Cypress sampled pre-restore state and produced a false product bug.
fix_summary: The round-trip spec now waits for restored session files plus the restored Waterfall default-view/layout state before asserting or drilling back into Waterfall, which closes the false failure and directly covers W026.
notes: Closed after rerunning `waterfall-session-roundtrip.cy.ts` with the corrected wait strategy on April 8, 2026. The app already preserved Waterfall as the restored default view; no product fix was required.

title: Keep dashboard Waterfall filtering rows aligned with the non-timeline filtered graph
observed_behavior: During dashboard filtering coverage, Waterfall could keep cluster rows derived from stale timeline-ignoring helper state and continue counting hidden singleton or small-cluster nodes after Minimum Cluster Size changed.
intended_behavior: A dashboard Waterfall pane should rebuild cluster rows and drilldown from the current non-timeline filtered graph and the active Minimum Cluster Size setting.
cause_summary: Waterfall consumed a shared non-timeline node helper that depended on mutable session cluster state, so dashboard filtering could leave Waterfall counting nodes that no longer belonged in the filtered non-timeline graph.
fix_summary: CommonService now derives non-timeline node and cluster state from the current visible links plus cluster minimum, and the maintained dashboard filtering journey now validates Waterfall's refreshed compact cluster rows and drilldown against that derived graph.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard filtering journey passed on April 10, 2026.
